q2_gaps: a two-object preposition ("between X and Y") needing a TERNARY relation — the instruction set licenses preposition-named obliques only in binary form (on an event, or entity-attached as with (From sk_wool_1 calderwick)), so the arity of (Between <entity> <a> <b>) is unspecified, and splitting it into two binary atoms would change the meaning
